Meridian Retrieval Evaluation Corpus

Travel Policy
TRV-104 requires employees to obtain manager approval before booking international travel. The approval must be recorded before purchase.

Service Contract
4.2(b) The customer must give written notice within ten business days after discovering a material service failure.

Pricing Table
Starter plan: 25 seats.
Growth plan: 100 seats.
Enterprise plan: 250 seats.

Exception Policy
Policy exceptions require the Finance Director's approval. The exception request must name the business reason.

Master Services Agreement
Renewal: Either party must provide 60 days' written notice before a renewal date to prevent automatic renewal.
Termination: Either party may terminate for convenience with 30 days' written notice.

Retention Policy A
Customer records must be retained for seven years after account closure.

Retention Policy B
Customer records must be retained for five years after account closure.

Onboarding Guide
This onboarding guide supersedes the old onboarding checklist issued in 2024.
